promotion.name: EWE
promotion.blurb: The upstart that stopped being an upstart. Owned by a football heir with a spreadsheet for every feeling, it books long, hard matches, signs everybody, and argues with the internet every Wednesday night.

roster.gimmick: A sad-eyed cowboy who drank his way out of the top spot, found himself in a field, and came back to win everything. He still apologises after every buckshot lariat.
roster.finisher_description: He springs off the top rope as his opponent stands, and clotheslines them out of their boots. Then he says sorry.

roster.gimmick: A video-game-loving genius who has had the best match of the year so often it is now in his contract. He nearly died, came back, and still flips like he is twenty-five.
roster.finisher_description: A fireman's carry lifted high and dropped into a sit-out driver.

roster.gimmick: A bleeding, grinning street fighter who has wrapped his own fists in things that are not tape. He runs a gang of believers and wants wrestling to hurt again.
roster.catchphrase: I came here to hurt. You came here to watch.
roster.finisher_description: A double underhook DDT, delivered after a twelve-hour shift.

roster.gimmick: A smooth, dangerous former champion who took the long way round to the top and sends everyone the bill for the trip.
roster.catchphrase: This is my neighbourhood. You're trespassing.
roster.finisher_description: He hoists his opponent into a pumphandle and drives them into his knee.

roster.gimmick: A rich, smirking Long Islander who knows he is better than you, and that you know it. He has a ring, a scarf and a lawyer for every occasion.
roster.finisher_description: A cradled tombstone piledriver, finished with a wave to the cheap seats.

roster.gimmick_category: Best Wrestler in the World (He Checked)
roster.gimmick: A Cockney daredevil who does things in the air that make doctors write letters. He calls his finishes by number and never runs out.
roster.finisher_description: A running elbow to the back of the head from out of a handspring.
roster.finisher_move: Handspring elbow to the back of the head

roster.gimmick: A Japanese legend who once made it rain money in arenas and now just makes it drizzle. He is unbearably smug and unbearably good.
roster.finisher_description: He spins his opponent by the wrist into a short-arm lariat that does not let go.

roster.gimmick: A painted skater who throws himself off things that are too high, onto things that are too hard. He climbed a real mountain to prove a point nobody had made.
roster.catchphrase: Nothing to lose. I already lost it.
roster.finisher_description: A falling senton off the top rope, feet first, eyes closed.

roster.gimmick: A sunglassed slacker who wrestles with his hands in his pockets and, somehow, wins. He has never been in a hurry and never will be.
roster.catchphrase: (He puts his hands in his pockets. That is the catchphrase.)
roster.finisher_description: A running punch thrown with his hands still almost in his pockets.

roster.gimmick: A smirking veteran who has betrayed every partner he ever had and now leads a family of people he insults.
roster.catchphrase: Respect your elders. Then step aside for them.
roster.finisher_description: A double-arm-trap twisting slam, the switch flipped off.

roster.gimmick: A Canadian legend who came back from a broken neck and a quiet retirement, to spear people he used to tag with.
roster.catchphrase: Rated PG-13. Parental guidance strongly suggested.
roster.finisher_description: A running tackle so hard it leaves a crater.

roster.gimmick_category: The Wizard of Twelve Thousand Words
roster.gimmick: A veteran who knows twelve thousand holds and has named all of them in a promo. He reinvents himself every year and keeps a list of everybody who did not notice.
roster.catchphrase: You just made the list. Of synonyms.
roster.finisher_description: A single-leg crab with a knee in the back, and a definition read aloud.

roster.gimmick: A precise, giant Swiss strongman who swings people round by the ankles and keeps perfect time while doing it.
roster.finisher_description: He spins his opponent by the ankles for as long as the crowd counts.
roster.finisher_move: Cradle lift into a reverse slam

roster.gimmick: A clean-cut student of the mat who joined a gang, bought a leather jacket and now practises sneering in the mirror.
roster.catchphrase: I'm dangerous now. Ask my mum.
roster.finisher_description: A trapped-arm rear submission he learned in school.

roster.gimmick_category: The Nastiest Man in the Building
roster.gimmick: A small, sharp, angry Englishman who does not care if you like him, which you do not.
roster.finisher_description: A corkscrew senton from the top rope.

roster.gimmick: A huge Japanese athlete who moves like a cruiserweight and hits like a crane. He belongs to a family of people who think they own wrestling.
roster.finisher_description: A lifting knee to the jaw from a man who should not jump that high.

roster.gimmick_category: The Rising Star That Will Not Stop Rising
roster.gimmick: A lanky Australian prodigy who has had more great matches than birthdays.
roster.catchphrase: Watch the sky. I'm in it.
roster.finisher_description: A spinning tombstone into the mat.

roster.gimmick: A flyer who has never once taken the stairs when he could take the air instead.
roster.finisher_description: A springboard 630 senton, the full turn and a bit.

roster.gimmick: A thick-necked veteran who chokes people to sleep and then does a promo over them in a calm voice.
roster.finisher_description: A rear naked choke, delivered gently, until it isn't.

roster.gimmick: A giant who never says much and does not need to.
roster.finisher_description: A spinebuster from twice the usual height.

roster.gimmick: The silent, scowling son of a commentator, who throws people around like wet laundry and never smiles.
roster.finisher_description: A sleeper hold from behind, until the lights go out.

roster.gimmick: A Delaware farmer who wrestles like the roosters are watching and he owes them money.
roster.finisher_description: A shooting star elbow drop.

roster.gimmick: One half of a brother tag team who hold executive titles in the company and use them mostly to give themselves good matches.
roster.finisher_description: A thrust kick to the jaw, usually in a set of six.

roster.gimmick: The younger brother, who does more flips and fewer meetings.
roster.finisher_description: A springboard into a spinning kick, then a bow.

roster.gimmick: A muscle-bound legend who joined the business of hurting people for money and keeps the receipts in his biceps.
roster.catchphrase: Hurt is business. Business is booming.
roster.finisher_description: A full nelson that squeezes until a contract is signed.

roster.gimmick_category: The Gold Standard of Being Underrated
roster.gimmick: A veteran athlete who was told he was underrated for twenty years and decided to make everybody pay for it.
roster.finisher_description: A step-up knee to the face.

roster.gimmick: The manager of the hurting business, who sells you a deal you did not want and a beating you did not ask for.
roster.finisher_description: A running knee in the corner while his clients hold you.

roster.gimmick: A smirking New Zealander who once ruled the biggest faction in Japan and now leads a cowboy gang that sells hats.
roster.catchphrase: It's still real to me, mate.
roster.finisher_description: A spinning reverse STO.

roster.gimmick: A loud, sequinned brawler who talks too fast and punches too hard.
roster.catchphrase: Juiced up and nowhere to go!
roster.finisher_description: A left-handed punch from the top rope.

roster.gimmick: A rapper who writes a diss track about every opponent and occasionally wrestles them.
roster.catchphrase: Mic drop. Then a real drop.
roster.finisher_description: A top-rope elbow, then the microphone.

roster.gimmick: The likeable half of a rapping tag team, who makes the crowd do a hand gesture they all pretend not to love.
roster.finisher_description: A sit-out powerbomb from a fireman's carry.

roster.gimmick_category: Ageless Dad of the Tag Division
roster.gimmick: A legend in his sixties who manages younger men and still throws a better punch.
roster.catchphrase: Respect your elders. Especially this one.
roster.finisher_description: A fireman's carry into a jumping neckbreaker.

roster.gimmick: Half of a moustached tag team who think tag wrestling died in 1989 and are trying to dig it up.
roster.catchphrase: Old school. No school. Top guys.
roster.finisher_description: A double-team bulldog into a backbreaker.

roster.gimmick: The other half, who drives the van and fixes the trophies.
roster.catchphrase: We're the best. Ask anyone over sixty.
roster.finisher_description: A double-team neckbreaker.

roster.gimmick: A furious, pudgy, beloved brawler who cuts promos about his feelings and backfists the people who caused them.
roster.catchphrase: I'm tired. I'm angry. I'm here.
roster.finisher_description: A spinning backfist, the size of a bin lid.

roster.gimmick: A country veteran who breaks guitars over heads and then sells the strings.
roster.catchphrase: Ain't my first rodeo. Or second guitar.
roster.finisher_description: A falling facebuster, guitar optional.

roster.gimmick: A veteran in a gold bodysuit who has been wrestling since before most of the roster was born.
roster.finisher_description: A bulldog off the ropes.

roster.gimmick: A huge, bearded brawler who leads a gang of dark misfits and punches like a slammed door.
roster.finisher_description: A sit-out powerbomb from a cutter position.

roster.gimmick: A tiny Canadian who kicks faster than people can blink and once kicked his way through a whole tournament.
roster.finisher_description: A cradled, spinning driver after a flurry of kicks.

roster.gimmick: A high-flying athlete who leaps like he is late for a flight.
roster.finisher_description: A frog splash from the far corner.

roster.gimmick: A small, fast, shouting flyer who arrives at full speed and leaves at fuller speed.
roster.finisher_description: A frog splash from the top rope.

roster.gimmick: A daredevil who leaps off things for a living and has a stunt double for his stunt double.
roster.finisher_description: A corkscrew shooting star press.

roster.gimmick: A small, bearded technician who grows his own vegetables and lives in a van to save money. Semi-retired, he wrestles when the crowd chants for him, which is always.
roster.catchphrase: He points to the sky and the arena chants: YAY! YAY! YAY!
roster.finisher_description: He traps one arm with his legs, cranks the face back with a forearm, and asks politely whether they would like to tap before he composts them.

roster.gimmick: A masked Mexican athlete who can lift a man with one arm while doing a handstand, and often does.
roster.finisher_description: A handstand into a lifted bridging suplex.

roster.gimmick: A shining luchador who flips across the ring like a coin someone threw for luck.
roster.finisher_description: A springboard shooting star press.

roster.gimmick: A luchador who walks the top rope like it is a sidewalk and lands everything on the way down.
roster.finisher_description: A rope-walk into a moonsault.

roster.gimmick: A veteran who has broken more backs than a bad mattress and is proud of it.
roster.finisher_description: A backbreaker into a powerbomb.

roster.gimmick: A quiet technician who twists legs like pretzels and gets very annoyed at noise.
roster.finisher_description: A pretzel-shaped leg lock.

roster.gimmick_category: Promotions Boss of the Back Room
roster.gimmick: A huge, slow-talking brawler who runs a crew of hard men and tells them where to stand.
roster.finisher_description: A package piledriver.

roster.gimmick: A flamboyant veteran who comes to the ring with two attendants and a peacock feather and leaves with neither.
roster.finisher_description: A Northern lights suplex into a German.
roster.finisher_move: Northern lights into a german suplex

roster.gimmick_category: Teen Prodigy With a Mother Problem
roster.gimmick: A teenage wonder whose mother manages him, books him, and is on his match card more than he is.
roster.catchphrase: Ask my mum. She's in charge.
roster.finisher_description: A spinning cutter from the top rope.

roster.gimmick: A woman who speaks only in old movie lines, wears pearls to fight, and believes it is 1948. The crowd believes it too.
roster.finisher_description: A cradle piledriver, delivered with a fan's flutter.

roster.gimmick: A champion who calls herself the boss, wears a cape, and bills every opponent by the hour.
roster.catchphrase: The CEO-ish will see you now. Invoice to follow.
roster.finisher_description: A short-arm, cross-legged crossface that stays until the shares change hands.

roster.gimmick: A strongwoman from outer space, or Long Island, who lifts people like groceries and stares at the lights.
roster.catchphrase: Take me to your leader. Then I'll lift them.
roster.finisher_description: A lifting powerbomb with a spin.

roster.gimmick: A beaming, singing, laughing powerhouse who powerbombs people while smiling.
roster.finisher_description: A lifting sit-out powerbomb.

roster.gimmick: A tough, smoking English brawler who lariats people and buys them a drink afterwards.
roster.finisher_description: A running lariat to the back of the head.

roster.gimmick: A fiery Mexican legend who fights for her people and paints her face for battle.
roster.finisher_description: A Michinoku driver.

roster.gimmick: A former starlet's assistant who stole the act, the gown and the spotlight.
roster.finisher_description: A running knee to the face.

roster.gimmick: A singing, dancing Australian who writes a jingle for every match and loses most of them.
roster.finisher_description: A diving crossbody.

roster.gimmick: A cheerful flyer who wears blue from head to toe and kicks people in the head.
roster.finisher_description: A kick to the head that she calls a diagnosis.

roster.gimmick: A young goth who joined a dark family and speaks in riddles nobody asked for.
roster.finisher_description: A seated arm-trap lock.

roster.gimmick: A pretty, quiet assassin who chokes people out with a smile.
roster.finisher_description: A rear naked choke from behind.

roster.gimmick: A Japanese veteran who brings a kendo stick to the ring and uses it more politely than you'd think.
roster.finisher_description: A running knee strike.

roster.gimmick: A cold, precise technician who teaches the women's division a lesson every week and grades it harshly.
roster.finisher_description: A sit-out powerbomb into a leg lock.
roster.finisher_move: Sit-out powerbomb into a leg lock

roster.gimmick: An English punk from a wrestling family who came back from a career-ending injury and has never stopped talking about it.
roster.finisher_description: A DDT from the corner.

roster.gimmick: A hulking, roaring powerhouse who treats every match as a hunt.
roster.finisher_description: A lifting cutter into a powerbomb.

roster.gimmick: A teenager who started wrestling before she could drive and treats every crowd like detention.
roster.catchphrase: I'm grounded. You're on the ground.
roster.finisher_description: A swinging side slam.

roster.gimmick: A fallen goddess who has held the brand's title longer than some shows have been on the air, and expects to be worshipped for it.
roster.finisher_description: A lifting powerbomb into a neckbreaker.

roster.gimmick: A young flyer the brand has bet on, who keeps losing and keeps being loved.
roster.finisher_description: A running bulldog.

roster.gimmick_category: The Owner Who Reads the Comments
roster.gimmick: The football heir who owns the company, books the shows, reads every comment and answers some of them.
A smug Canadian manager who leads a family of the best wrestlers in the company and talks while they work.
roster.catchphrase: Don't look at me. Look at my family.

roster.gimmick: A masked commentator who knows every match in history and explains all of them, during the current one.
A veteran voice who has interviewed everybody, twice, and starts every answer with 'well'.
The legendary voice of a generation, who still calls the big ones and calls everybody 'partner'.
roster.catchphrase: Business is about to pick up, partner.

roster.gimmick: A face-painted legend who retired undefeated in his last company and now appears from the rafters on birthdays.
roster.catchphrase: One more time. Just once. Probably.
roster.finisher_description: A sharpshooter-shaped leg lock with a scorpion's sting.
